title: Design System: Anupat Kaewmee — Engineering Portfolio

title.purpose: Project card titles, experience roles, and university title (h3).

body.purpose: Bilingual prose with automatic TH (1.75) and EN (1.6) line-height.

label.purpose: Technical stack badges, step counters, and tabular metrics.

shadows.name: structural-whisper
shadows.purpose: Subtle structural elevation for white cards on the slate canvas.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Crisp deceleration for lens switches, hover transitions, and copy feedback.

components.name: Primary Resume Button
components.description: High-contrast slate primary CTA for downloading the PDF resume.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1e293b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-badge { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; background: #1e293b; color: #cbd5e1; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Action Button
components.description: Crisp white bordered button for secondary navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; background: #ffffff; color: #334155; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4); color: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Architecture Layer Chip
components.description: Monospace indigo badge identifying a system component in the architecture flow.
components.css: .ds-chip-arch { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #4f46e5; background: rgba(238, 242, 255, 0.8); border: 1px solid #c7d2fe; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Operational Impact Callout
components.description: Emerald callout box highlighting verified business and operational outcomes.
components.html:
OPERATIONAL IMPACT

Enabled field agents to execute end-to-end service operations remotely within one unified platform.
components.css: .ds-callout-impact { padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: #ecfdf5; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; color: #047857; } .ds-callout-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-callout-text { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Dual-Lens Segmented Switcher
components.description: Segmented toggle switching project cards between Business Impact and System Architecture views.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; gap: 4px; } .ds-seg-btn { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: none; background: transparent; color: #475569; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-seg-active { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: The Architecture Ledger treats a software engineer's portfolio like a living technical specification from Stripe Docs or Linear (Light). Rather than decorating enterprise work with dark cyber gradients or synthetic mockups, the interface uses crisp paper-white containers on a cool slate canvas, 1px structural hairlines, and semantic color coding that distinguishes business outcomes from system architecture.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight-first corporate-engineering surface hierarchy (#F8FAFC canvas, #FFFFFF cards, #F1F5F9 recessed diagram wells).
Semantic three-accent discipline: Engineering Blue for interactive controls, Architecture Indigo for system layers, and Impact Emerald for verified business outcomes and academic honors.
Bilingual typographic precision with automatic vertical rhythm adaptation between English (line-height: 1.6) and Thai (line-height: 1.75).
Interactive Dual-Lens switching (global and per-card) that transforms prose case studies into structured architectural node pipelines.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Never mix accent roles for decoration: Blue means interactive/navigation, Indigo means system architecture, and Emerald means verified outcome/honors.

rules.name: The Tinted-Ink Rule
rules.body: Text placed on a tinted accent surface (#EFF6FF, #EEF2FF, #ECFDF5) must use a deep shade of that same hue (#172554, #1E1B4B, #047857) rather than neutral gray or slate.

rules.name: The Bilingual Breathing Room Rule
rules.body: Dynamically bind lang="th" or lang="en" on <html> so Thai copy automatically receives line-height: 1.75 to accommodate upper and lower vowel/tone marks without clipping.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section headings stand on their own typographic weight; never place decorative uppercase eyebrows or arbitrary section numbers above <h2> headings.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface is bounded by a 1px solid #E2E8F0 border that shifts toward #CBD5E1 or rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4) on hover. Never use wide blurry drop shadows or colored neon glows.

dos: Do keep the page strictly in Minimalist Light Mode (#F8FAFC canvas, #FFFFFF cards, #0F172A headings).
Do support both global and per-card toggling between Business Impact and System Architecture views.
Do use tabular-nums on all GPA metrics, counts, step indices, and phone numbers.
Do theme browser defaults (::selection, :focus-visible, scrollbars, caret) to match Engineering Blue (#2563EB).
donts: Don't use dark-mode backgrounds, neon gradients, or gradient text.
Don't place neutral gray/slate text on colored pastel backgrounds (#EFF6FF, #EEF2FF, #ECFDF5); always tint the text to the matching deep hue.
Don't add decorative two-axis CSS grid-line backgrounds or uppercase eyebrow kickers above section headings.
Don't fabricate screenshots or metrics for internal NDA-bound insurance systems.
